subject: maths

concepts.title: Addition of Algebraic Expressions
concepts.definition: A method of combining multiple algebraic terms by grouping like terms together and summing their respective numerical coefficients.
concepts.key_idea: Only terms with identical variable factors can be added together.
question_patterns: add the algebraic expressions
find the sum of
how to add expressions
calculate the total of these polynomials
Add 3x + 2y and 5x - y by stacking columns.

solution_steps.action: Group the like terms from all the given expressions
solution_steps.explain: Align terms with identical variable parts together in columns or groups.

solution_steps.action: Add the coefficients of the like terms
solution_steps.explain: Combine the numerical coefficients of the grouped like terms while keeping the variable part unchanged.
Combine the summed like terms and any remaining unlike terms into a single simplified expression.

concepts.title: Subtraction of Algebraic Expressions
concepts.definition: To take one expression from another, flip every sign of the expression being taken away, then combine like terms.
concepts.key_idea: Invert the sign of every term in the expression being subtracted before combining like terms.
question_patterns: subtract one expression from another
find the difference between
how to subtract polynomials
what do we get when we subtract
Take 4a - 3 away from 7a + 5.

solution_steps.action: Align the expressions with like terms
solution_steps.explain: Write the expression to be subtracted below the original expression, aligning like terms vertically.

solution_steps.action: Invert the signs of the second expression
solution_steps.explain: Change the sign of each term in the expression being subtracted to its additive inverse.

solution_steps.action: Perform addition on the aligned terms
solution_steps.explain: Add the terms vertically using their new signs to find the final simplified difference.

concepts.title: Multiplication of Two Monomials
concepts.definition: Finding the product of two single-term expressions by multiplying their coefficients and adding the exponents of identical variables.
concepts.key_idea: The product of coefficients forms the new coefficient, and variable powers are combined using exponent laws.
question_patterns: multiply the monomials
find the product of two monomials
calculate the product of
what is the product of these single term expressions
Multiply 4x^2 by 3x^3.

solution_steps.explain: Separate the numerical coefficients and the algebraic variable factors of both monomials.
Find the product of the numerical coefficients of the two monomials.
Combine identical variables by adding their exponents according to exponent rules.
Write the final product as a single monomial term.

concepts.title: Multiplication of Three or More Monomials
concepts.definition: Extending monomial multiplication to three or more terms by multiplying all numerical coefficients and combining all variable parts sequentially or simultaneously.
concepts.key_idea: Monomial multiplication is associative and commutative, meaning the order of terms does not affect the product.
question_patterns: find the product of three monomials
multiply multiple monomials
calculate the product of three or more terms
what is the product of these monomials
Multiply 2x, 3y and 4z together.

solution_steps.explain: Collect the coefficients of all monomials and multiply them together.
Group identical variable bases together and sum their exponents across all monomials.
Write the combined coefficient and variable parts as a single simplified monomial.

concepts.title: Area of a Rectangle with Monomial Dimensions
concepts.definition: When a rectangle's sides are single-term expressions, multiply them to state the covered region.
concepts.key_idea: Single-term length times single-term breadth builds the region.
question_patterns: find the area of a rectangle with length and breadth
calculate the area of a rectangle whose sides are monomials
what is the area of a rectangle with given dimensions
find the product of length and breadth to get area
A rectangle has sides 5x and 3y -- state the region covered.

solution_steps.explain: The area of a rectangle is the product of its length and breadth.

concepts.title: Volume of a Rectangular Box with Monomial Dimensions
concepts.definition: Determining the space occupied by a rectangular prism where the length, width, and height are given as monomials.
concepts.key_idea: The product of three monomial dimensions yields the volume of the rectangular box.
question_patterns: find the volume of a rectangular box
calculate the volume of a box with given length breadth and height
what is the volume of a rectangular box with monomial sides
obtain the volume of a rectangular box
A box measures x, 2x and 3x -- state its capacity.

solution_steps.explain: The volume of a rectangular box is the product of its length, breadth, and height.

concepts.title: Multiplying a Monomial by a Binomial
concepts.definition: Multiplying a single-term expression by a two-term expression by distributing the single term to each term of the binomial.
concepts.key_idea: Hand each part of the two-part expression the single term outside.
question_patterns: multiply a monomial by a binomial
find the product of a monomial and a binomial
use distributive law to multiply
calculate the product of a single term and two terms
Expand 2x(3a + 4b).

solution_steps.action: Distribute monomial to the first term
solution_steps.explain: Multiply the monomial by the first term of the binomial.

solution_steps.action: Distribute monomial to the second term
solution_steps.explain: Multiply the monomial by the second term of the binomial.
Combine the two resulting terms into a single algebraic expression.

concepts.title: Multiplying a Monomial by a Trinomial
concepts.definition: Hand every one of the trio the single term outside: three products result.
concepts.key_idea: Distribute the monomial multiplier to all three terms of the trinomial.
question_patterns: multiply a monomial by a trinomial
find the product of a monomial and a trinomial
simplify the product of a single term and three terms
calculate the product of a monomial and a three term expression
Expand x(2a + 3b - c).

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the monomial by each of the three terms in the trinomial individually.
Write the sum of the three resulting terms as a single algebraic expression.

concepts.title: Multiplying a Binomial by a Binomial
concepts.definition: Pair every term of the first two-part expression with every term of the second.
concepts.key_idea: Every part of the first pairs with every part of the second; then tidy like terms.
question_patterns: multiply two binomials
find the product of two binomials
how to multiply binomials
simplify the product of two term expressions
Expand (x + 2)(x + 5) and simplify.

solution_steps.action: Multiply first term of first binomial by second binomial
solution_steps.explain: Distribute the first term of the first binomial to both terms of the second binomial.

solution_steps.action: Multiply second term of first binomial by second binomial
solution_steps.explain: Distribute the second term of the first binomial to both terms of the second binomial.
Identify any terms with identical variable parts and add their coefficients to simplify the expression.

concepts.title: Multiplying a Binomial by a Trinomial
concepts.definition: Multiplying a two-term expression by a three-term expression by distributing each term of the binomial to all three terms of the trinomial.
concepts.key_idea: Two parts meet three parts: up to six products before tidying.
question_patterns: multiply a binomial by a trinomial
find the product of a binomial and a trinomial
simplify the product of a two term and a three term expression
how to multiply a binomial and a trinomial
Expand (a + 2)(3a - 1 + b).

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the first term of the binomial by all three terms of the trinomial.
Multiply the second term of the binomial by all three terms of the trinomial.
Group and add coefficients of any like terms among the six resulting terms to get the final simplified expression.
